decision.summary: A transient 3D perturbation is observed centered at indices 522–523: U drops sharply (~−10 MAD), N and E show concurrent positive spikes. U shows only partial recovery by index 525, and no clear return to pre-event level on any axis is confirmed within allowed context [485,560]. The candidate jump at 495 lies outside the screened region and lacks supporting evidence of a temporary offset (no opposing return or sustained interior); it is not interpreted as a temporary interval.

intervals.observation: Sharp negative U spike (≈−10 MAD) at 522–523, with concurrent positive N and E excursions; partial U recovery by 525 but no clear return to pre-spike baseline on any axis. Sustained interior not established; return ambiguous.
